caption: The drawing depicts a quilt composed of nine square panels arranged in a 3x3 grid, each with a distinct design. The quilt has a brown patterned border with small, repetitive geometric shapes, and the top left corner is turned down to reveal a pink patterned underside. The background of each panel is an off-white or light beige color. The top left panel shows three orange circular objects with blue leaves and stems. The top center panel features a red bird perched on a curved green branch. The top right panel displays two red flowers with green stems and leaves. The middle left panel has a circular arrangement of green and red shapes with white stars on them, resembling petals or segments, with text in the center. The middle center panel contains three large flowers in shades of purple, pink, and red with green leaves. The middle right panel features a central red heart with green accents and red and green patterned crescent shapes around it. The bottom left panel shows three red tulips with green stems and leaves. The bottom center panel depicts a red animal with white spots above a green bird with a red head and a round, spotted green shape. The bottom right panel shows a person dressed in pink riding an orange horse. Each panel has different details, colors, and configurations. Some panels also include text or signatures near the bottom edge.
title: Doll Bed Applique Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
